method: Read all five exact files, compare original/candidate diff and byte-identical suffix beginning command.env(CHILD_PID_FILE). No source execution or native tools.
findings: Only Windows fixture launch changes. Unix shell fixture and the complete suffix from command.env(CHILD_PID_FILE) through both original test functions are byte-identical.

Wrapper and descendant use the same current test executable, the original exact case name and --quiet, with an explicit wrapper/child role. The early process exit is reached only after a recognized helper role; normal test invocation without that role continues into original assertions.

The native descendant explicitly inherits standard handles and requests no new group/job/breakaway flag. Existing production spawn still attempts suspended assignment to the Job Object before resume; its compatibility fallback remains unchanged and is not assumed contained by this review.

WaitForChild waits for the real descendant. ExitBeforeTimeout exits after the original release signal while the descendant can still hold output handles; the original wait-with-output 100 ms timeout and None assertion remain decisive rather than assuming wrapper exit equals pipe completion.
The actual environment scrubber only removes its closed NON_INHERITABLE_ENV_VARS list, which does not include the new fixture role or path variables.
No new #[test] or production policy change is introduced. Original readiness 30 s, wrapper-exit 10 s, command timeout 100 ms, descendant release and 3 s survived-marker observation are unchanged.
boundaries: Static source review is not Windows Job Object/handle inheritance qualification. Actual original 33-case Git and retained queue gates must run.
The fixed 3 s survived-marker observation retains its original finite scheduling scope; it is not a proof of process termination under arbitrary scheduler delay.
The planned no-containment negative mutant was not read or executed in this review; no result is claimed.
Helper environment roles are a fixture protocol, not a security boundary or replacement for exact outer native test inventory.
